"""Primary-only r4 filename repair verification; original ledger stays frozen."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path('/tmp/yulang-source-interaction-01a17247-20261025')
OLD_HELPER = ROOT / 'notes/theory/lean/.lake/source-generated-interaction-20261025-run.py'
exec(compile(OLD_HELPER.read_text().split('\nselection = sys.argv[1]')[0], str(OLD_HELPER), 'exec'))
OLD_LEDGER = LEDGER
assert digest(OLD_LEDGER) == '132cab00236c36c7072d5fdf11eccb86681fc6ebc2c34a6351887e89282a0b43'
CONTRACT4 = ROOT / 'tasks/agent-loop/sprints/source-generated-interaction-20261025-r4-public-filename.md'
assert digest(CONTRACT4) == '7503d09945b31a065c9747be0761af8c93b319d2798ff1fda6984d16414db193'
REVIEW = ROOT / 'tasks/agent-loop/inbox/20261025-source-generated-native-review.md'
assert digest(REVIEW) == 'ffb247950c6111a022883cbec8af545cac1dc71f7a848cd0a6d6d13aac765f6d'
FIX = ROOT / 'tasks/agent-loop/inbox/20261025-source-generated-public-filename-repair.md'
LEDGER = ROOT / 'tasks/agent-loop/inbox/20261025-source-generated-r4-verification.jsonl'
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in LEDGER.read_text().splitlines()] if LEDGER.exists() else []
selection = sys.argv[1]
inputs = dict(pins)
for path in [CONTRACT, ISOLATION, CONTRACT4, OLD_HELPER, Path(__file__), OLD_LEDGER,
             REVIEW, FIX, EXAMPLE, NATIVE_HANDOFF, ROOT / 'Cargo.toml', ROOT / 'Cargo.lock',
             ROOT / 'tools/inference-playground/Cargo.toml',
             ROOT / 'crates/yu-hir/src/module.rs', ROOT / 'crates/yu-hir/src/module/source_exports.rs']:
    inputs[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = digest(path)
    assert digest(path) != 'MISSING', str(path)
outputs = []
if selection == 'cargo-build':
    assert not rows
    kind, timeout = 'cargo', 60
    cmd = ['cargo', 'build', '--locked', '--offline', '-p', 'yu-playground',
           '--example', 'source_generated_interaction_20261025', '-j1']
    outputs = [BINARY]
elif selection == 'public':
    assert len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[2] in ('immediate', 'escaping')
    case = sys.argv[2]
    assert rows and rows[0]['selection'] == 'cargo-build'
    build = rows[0]
    assert build['exit_status'] == 0 and not build['timeout']
    assert len(rows) < 3 and not any(row['command'][-2:] == [case, 'public'] for row in rows)
    assert digest(BINARY) == build['output_hashes'][str(BINARY.relative_to(ROOT))]
    assert digest(EXAMPLE) == build['input_hashes'][str(EXAMPLE.relative_to(ROOT))]
    kind, timeout = 'native', 30
    inputs[str(BINARY.relative_to(ROOT))] = digest(BINARY)
    cmd = [str(BINARY), case, 'public']
else:
    raise SystemExit('unknown selection')
before = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(path) for path in outputs}
start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
tick = time.monotonic()
timed_out = False
try:
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
    code, stdout, stderr = result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
    timed_out, code = True, None
    stdout, stderr = exc.stdout or '', exc.stderr or ''
    if isinstance(stdout, bytes): stdout = stdout.decode(errors='replace')
    if isinstance(stderr, bytes): stderr = stderr.decode(errors='replace')
duration = time.monotonic() - tick
after = {path: digest(ROOT / path) for path in inputs}
row = dict(index=len(rows)+1, revision='r4', kind=kind, selection=selection, command=cmd,
           cwd=str(ROOT), start_utc=start, end_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
           duration_seconds=duration, exit_status=code, timeout=timed_out,
           input_hashes=inputs, input_hashes_after=after, output_hashes_before=before,
           output_hashes={str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(path) for path in outputs},
           source_text=EXAMPLE.read_text(), runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text(), stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
           prior_ledger_sha256=digest(OLD_LEDGER), prior_native_attempts=4, prior_cargo_builds=1)
with LEDGER.open('a') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
    stream.flush()
    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
print(json.dumps({key: row[key] for key in ['index','kind','selection','exit_status','timeout','duration_seconds']}))
if kind == 'native':
    print('\n'.join(line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('CASE=') and 'status=' in line))
if code != 0:
    print(stderr[-1500:])
assert inputs == after, 'input changed during check'
assert code == 0 and not timed_out
